title: Continuum Bundle Administration Rate for Microsoft 365 Users Already Under Backup
content:
**Bundle clause.** Clients whose Continuum Backup & Recovery plan already protects their Microsoft 365 users take a bundle administration rate on Microsoft 365 Cloud Subscriptions (CSP):

- **Full protection.** The client has an active Continuum plan protecting at least as many Microsoft 365 users as the licenses the administration fee counts. The plan's administration fee per license is multiplied by **90 percent**.
- **Partial protection.** The client has an active Continuum plan protecting at least one Microsoft 365 user, but fewer than the licenses counted. The fee is multiplied by **95 percent**.
- **Otherwise.** No bundle rate applies.

**Counting protected users.** The Microsoft 365 users protected are the active Continuum plan's own protections of Microsoft 365 users, less its own removals of them. Protections recorded under any other Continuum plan of the client, open or closed, are not counted.

**Records read.**

- The Continuum Backup & Recovery plan's status comes from the plan record.
- The protections and removals come from that plan's device changes whose device class is Microsoft 365 user.

## Decision table

| Active Continuum plan | Microsoft 365 users protected by that plan, compared with the licenses counted | Effect on the plan's fee per license |
|---|---|---|
| yes | equal or more | multiplied by 90 percent |
| yes | at least one, but fewer | multiplied by 95 percent |
| yes | none | no bundle rate |
| no | — | no bundle rate |

## Hypothetical illustration

A subscription counts 40 licenses. The client's active Continuum plan records 45 Microsoft 365 user protections and 3 removals, so it protects 42 users. 42 is at least 40, so the rate is 90 percent. A closed Continuum plan of the same client, with 30 protections of its own, adds nothing to the 42.

If the active plan protected 25 users, the rate would be 95 percent.
